offering_description.value: Operates route-based video gaming terminals placed in taverns, bars, truck stops and restaurants, and shares net terminal income with those host venues. Sells gaming play to adult consumers and terminal placement to venue operators.

primary_services.value: terminal route operations; terminal placement and maintenance; venue revenue sharing

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult players of gaming terminals at host venues; B2B: tavern, bar, restaurant and truck stop operators hosting terminals

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: share of net terminal income from gaming play on its terminals; commissions or management fees: revenue share paid to host venues for terminal placement
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gaming terminal fleet placed in host venues, taking net gaming income and paying host share to venue operators; service provider: maintains terminals and route operations for host venues and sells gaming play to players

geography_served.value: US regional: Illinois, with some operations in a few other states

specialization.value: niche specialist: gaming terminal route operations and placement, with related casino and venue offerings

distribution_channels.value: other: terminals placed directly in host taverns, bars, restaurants and truck stops; own locations: owned and operated gaming locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gaming licenses and terminal approvals from state gaming regulators, such as the Illinois Gaming Board

notes: Geographic footprint and some product scope may have changed; states and own-location details are not fully certain.
